name: clio-toolkit
description: Byrd Law Group's Clio Manage toolkit for a plaintiff's PI practice: connect to Clio, run deadline-first matter analysis, a firm-wide deadline/SOL radar, and a stale-matter pulse; open new MVA matters, run the MVA pre-litigation intake workflow, and apply reusable task/deadline templates; upload/edit documents; draft client text updates, demand letters, and standard correspondence (LOR/HIPAA/spoliation); and track medical bills/liens and special damages.
